rules.description: A plan that names itself as the resolution it came from is a cycle, and a cycle here defeats the one-way rule canon states outright: the concrete startup plan points back to the exact recipe and resolution, never the reverse. Cheap to check and impossible to see by reading a record with forty-six refs in it.

The resolution's hash covers a record that CONTAINS the recipe reference, so the two commitments cannot be the same bytes. Equality means one was copied into the other — the plausible defect when four hash fields are wired in a row — and it would leave the plan claiming to have frozen two predecessors while having frozen one.
